import polars as pl
import thinkthen as tt

# a number column on your own scale: 0.06, 0.99, and 2.0
df = pl.DataFrame({"body": [
    "Please update my mailing address when you can.",
    "Can you send the signed contract by Friday?",
    "Nobody can log in to the site right now."]})
levels = ["Routine.", "Soon.", "Immediate."]
urgency = tt.score("How urgent is this?", df["body"], levels)
print(df.with_columns(urgency=urgency))
